retained_failures_and_assumptions: The first build passed a Creature pointer to a Unit-reference spline constructor; corrected before deployment. Initial migration replay exposed floating size equality and was corrected to a bounded comparison. Neither was treated as live gameplay evidence.

A direct upward Aleifir flight intersects the cave roof. A first eastward low route also intersected rising ground. The final shared route rises5yd on the eastward leg and passes both native VMAP ray legs and <=1yd terrain/cave samples. These are authored waypoints, not recovered retail choreography.

Direct continuous navmesh queries from the starter to mountain sites produced partial results without node exhaustion. They are not admitted as success. The replacement feasibility checks require a complete native corridor to each real physical join, then replay supporting floors/body clearance and bounded manual walk/jump/fall samples to interaction range/LOS. No navmesh data or runtime player movement is generated or altered.

Physical locomotion fixtures use native gravity19.291105, a selected standard jump impulse7.95555, <=7yd/s horizontal speed, <=1yd rise and <=12yd fall per arc. The impulse/body proxy and manual input are assumptions, not a capture of every race/client. There are20/4/15/5/14 arc edges for Aleifir/Hrafsir/Erilar/Hridmogir/Vethir respectively. This is a feasibility witness, not a recommended natural route or proof of actual player movement.

Initial local surveys/arc samples/Erilar join checks were rejected; the final fixtures enlarge the search, check40 arc samples with15 body rays and terrain protection, and include a validated real Erilar join hop. Removing intermediate locomotion is rejected; a nearby floor or partial corridor cannot replace the route.
